h2: Private Plumber Denpasar for Villas & Shop-Houses
intro: When a mixer drips at 2 a.m. or PDAM drops supply mid-shower, you need someone who arrives, finds the real cause and fixes it properly. That's what I do as your plumber — one person, no dispatch desk — across Renon, Sesetan, Panjer and the rest of the city.

sections.h3: Why Plumbing Fails More Often Here Than You'd Expect
sections.text: PDAM mains in this part of Bali run old, and supply can drop without warning. In tight shop-house lanes, shared drains clog fast when several units flush at once, and during heavy rain city channels overflow, pushing grey water back through floor drains. A properly sized tank, a working float valve and a reliable pump keep your villa running through all of it — I install, repair and service each one.

sections.h3: What I Actually Fix Around Here
sections.text: Leaking mixers under basins, cisterns that never stop filling, low pressure on upper floors of Renon apartments, washing-machine hoses bursting behind kitchen cabinets — these come up weekly in my work here. I also handle full toilet and basin installations, dishwasher hook-ups, and replacing corroded traps or flexible hoses gone brittle from sun exposure. One visit, one person, the job done.

sections.h3: Send Me Photos Before We Talk
sections.text: Open WhatsApp, snap two or three clear shots of the problem area — the tap, the cistern interior, the pipe joint, whatever is leaking or not working. Add a line about what you've noticed (constant dripping? no hot water? gurgling in the drain?) and which street you're on. That's enough for me to tell you whether it's a ten-minute fix or needs a part ordered, and we agree on scope before I drive over.

sections.h3: Small Habits That Save You Bigger Bills
sections.text: Check your float valve every few months; a worn seal means the tank runs dry and the pump cycles non-stop. In Panjer and Sesetan, where drainage backs up in monsoon season, keep floor-drain covers clean and consider fitting a check-valve at the lowest point. Electric water heaters should be descaled regularly — limescale builds up fast here and kills heating elements. Five minutes of attention now beats an emergency call at six p.m.

faq.q: Do you cover all of Denpasar?
faq.a: Yes — Renon, Sidakarya, Panjer, Sesetan, Kesiman, Denpasar Barat and surrounding streets. If you're within the city limits I can get there.

faq.q: How do I get a quote without calling anyone?
faq.a: Send photos and a short description on WhatsApp; I'll look them through and give you a clear answer on what the job involves before anything else.

faq.q: Can you handle both electric and gas water heaters?
faq.a: Both types come up regularly in family homes around here, and I service, repair or replace whichever one is installed in your villa.
